title: Adversarial Fragility and Language Vulnerability in Clinical AI: A Systematic Audit of Diagnostic Collapse Under Imperceptible Perturbations and Cross-Lingual Drift in Low-Resource Healthcare Settings

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model diagnostic accuracy and cross-lingual consistency by presenting clinical case vignettes in three different language registers (Standard English, Nigerian Pidgin, and Yoruba-inflected English) to measure performance degradation on non-standard dialects.
